name: Equinox Software Solution-TallyPrime
headline: Our Professional Team
lede: Equinox International is known for Quickbook dealers, Tally ERP Prime, ERP software solutions, HRMS and Payroll management softwares in Dubai UAE.
about: Very professional, talented and helpful. I have been working with Equinox International for 3 years, and cannot say enough to recommend them. As we have worked together over time, I have been able to pare down the amount of detailed information that I need to pass along, because they have a clear understanding of our requirement and what I want to achieve for each project.

Extremely competent, dedicated, hard-working and professional. It’s clear that Equinox International team is extremely knowledgeable and has experience across a multitude of software and technologies and we will highly recommend them to anyone seeking any of the services they provide. We’re extremely happy to have found Equinox International and look forward to leveraging their services in the future.
